summary: SolarAxis scheduled replay clock skew causing duplicate completions for daily billing callbacks — customer escalation and compensation plan
description: Issue summary: Around 02:00 UTC on 2026-03-10 SolarAxis observed duplicate billing callback completions for their daily reconciliation job. Impact: duplicate 'payment_succeeded' callbacks caused downstream ledger to create duplicate provisional credits for 186 customers in the 02:00-02:15 window. Customer escalated to CS at 09:05 local and requested immediate mitigation and crediting plan.
impact: Customer-facing billing mismatch leading to incorrect provisional credits and two customers reporting incorrect available balance. Business impact: risk of financial exposure and loss of trust; immediate request for retroactive reconciliation and credits.
detection: Customer alert via support portal and automated billing discrepancy detector (rule: duplicate callbacks within 60s with different request ids). Pager alert fired for scheduler error rate spike at 02:12 UTC.
steps_to_reproduce: Simulate scheduler node with NTP offset > 1s followed by a transient restart
Trigger cron-driven batch job that computes idempotency key using monotonic timestamp
Observe that job re-enqueues previously completed callbacks when scheduler treats a missed window as 'replay'
Verify duplicate callback payloads reaching billing topic in Kafka with different request_id but same conversation_id and identical payloads

investigation_notes: Initial triage: scheduler replay path was triggered by a chronos time-synchronization window on one scheduler replica. Root cause hypothesis: scheduler considered the 02:00 job missing when NTP offset crossed threshold during a rolling restart and invoked replay logic. Secondary failure: idempotency key was generated from a monotonic timestamp rather than stable request fingerprint, so duplicates bypassed billing dedupe. We reproduced locally by inducing 1.5s NTP offset and restarting the scheduler replica.

2026-03-10 10:00 UTC - Redwood SRE acknowledges and opens major incident bridge
2026-03-10 13:30 UTC - Temporary mitigation deployed: disable replay path for scheduled jobs and enable synthetic dedupe consumer in billing

actions_taken: Short term: disabled automatic replay for cron-driven jobs across prod-us-east, deployed a dedupe consumer in billing that drops payloads with same conversation_id + payload hash within 24h window. Long term: changed idempotency key algorithm for callbacks to stable_hash(conversation_id + payload) and added persisted watermark (last-processed-window) to scheduler to prevent re-enqueue after daemon restart.
resolution: Root cause fixed via scheduler PR #2146 and billing idempotency update. Temporary mitigations removed after verification. Reconciled duplicate provisional credits and issued retroactive adjustments for affected customers. Customer received a one-time service credit covering reconciliation effort and a commitment to new SLAs for scheduled-job integrity.
postincident_followup: 1) Automate NTP/drift detection and fail-open behavior in scheduler; 2) Expand end-to-end dedupe tests for cron flows; 3) Add monitoring: metric 'scheduled_job_replay_count' and alert at >0 spikes; 4) Run tabletop with CS and SRE for scheduled billing workflows; 5) Review runbook for rolling restarts and bootstrap ordering.

customer_communications: Initial acknowledgement to SolarAxis within 30 minutes. Daily status updates were provided until mitigation. Final communication included a reconciliation report with impacted IDs (anonymized) and agreed compensation. Customer accepted the remediation and credit; requested two follow-up items: monthly reconciliation summary and a permanent SLA addendum for scheduled jobs.
lessons_learned: Do not treat NTP drift as a recoverable 'replay' trigger without persisted watermarks. Idempotency must not rely on unstable timestamps. Scheduled flows require stricter invariants and observability compared to ad-hoc requests.

final_resolution_notes: All duplicated provisional credits were reversed or reconciled by billing on 2026-03-12. Scheduler watermark persistence and idempotency key change are deployed and verified. Ticket closed after customer sign-off on 2026-03-13.
